'''AG-11''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A counterpart of [[D-2B8]], Agee was onboard [[Carrick Station]] when he learned of his [[Attack on Rhinnal|destruction]] along with the frigate ''[[Toron Voq]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
AG-11 is the source of the flashpoint "''[[Red Reaper]]''".<ref name="TOR" />
